facts.fact: Regulations relating to the Processing of Data Subjects' Health Information by Certain Responsible Parties, 2026, made under section 112(2)(c) of POPIA, were published in Government Gazette 54268 on 6 March 2026 and commence on publication.
The regulations were made and signed on 27 February 2026 by Adv Pansy Tlakula as Chairperson of the Information Regulator.
